title: USS Indianapolis Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
Indianapolis Congressional Gold Medal Act

(Sec. 3) This bill requires the House of Representatives and the Senate to make appropriate arrangements for the award, on behalf of Congress, of a single gold medal of appropriate design to the crew of the USS Indianapolis, in recognition of their perseverance, bravery, and service to the United States.

Following the award of the gold medal, it shall be given to the Indiana War Memorial Museum in Indianapolis, Indiana, where it will be displayed and made available for research.

It is the sense of Congress that the Indiana War Memorial Museum should make the gold medal available for display elsewhere, particularly at other locations and events associated with the USS Indianapolis.

summary.headline: A 2018 law directs Congress to award a single gold medal to the crew of the USS Indianapolis and then give it to a museum in Indiana.
summary.what_it_does: The law asks the House and Senate to arrange a Congressional Gold Medal for the ship's crew, recognizing their perseverance, bravery, and service. After the award, the medal goes to the Indiana War Memorial Museum in Indianapolis to be displayed and made available for research. Congress also expresses its sense that the museum should lend the medal to other locations and events connected to the ship.
